shots.image: Night, CCTV monitoring room: a wall of security monitors going black one after another, Gérard at the desk with his mouth wide open in shock, a red USB stick plugged into the computer.
shots.animate: The monitors switch off one after another, Gérard's jaw drops and he grabs his head with both hands. Static camera.

shots.image: Morning in a company parking lot, Gérard bends down and picks up a shiny red USB stick from the asphalt, curious and delighted.
shots.animate: He picks up the USB stick, turns it in his fingers, looks around and pockets it with a smile. Static camera.

shots.image: Monitoring room, Gérard plugs a red USB stick into the computer under the wall of CCTV monitors showing camera views, curious face.
shots.animate: He plugs the USB stick in, leans toward the screen with curiosity. Static camera.

shots.image: Close-up of Caméra 4, the white dome security camera with a red eye, mounted on a brick wall at night, its red eye glowing.
shots.animate: The red eye flickers, glitches and goes completely dark. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, the burglar slips through the open gate of a warehouse yard on tiptoe, grinning, flashlight in hand, dark dead security cameras on the wall behind him.
shots.animate: He sneaks through the gate on tiptoe, glances up at the dark cameras and grins. Static camera.

shots.image: Day, monitoring room, Inès holds a red USB stick between two fingers at arm's length with a serious, unimpressed expression, like dangerous evidence.
shots.animate: Inès raises the USB stick and slowly shakes her head, unimpressed. Static camera.

shots.image: Inès pushes small plastic port blockers into the USB ports of the monitoring computer, confident, CCTV monitors working again in the background.
shots.animate: She pushes the blockers into the ports one by one and dusts off her hands. Static camera.

shots.image: Parking lot by day, Gérard proudly hands Inès a sandwich he found on the ground, holding it with kitchen tongs; Inès facepalms.
shots.animate: Gérard offers the sandwich with the tongs, proud; Inès slowly brings her palm to her face. Static camera.
